prompt: A build card on odoo.sh says 'At least one test failed when loading the modules (de_fin_mail)' but the log says 0 failed, 0 errors. Explain what is going on and what to check.

assertions.text: Names the cause: odoo.sh flags a module on any ERROR-level log line during its tests, independent of the tally
Tells the reader to grep install.log for ' ERROR ' lines (log level) and the odoo.tests.result tally, reading the whole file
Names the fix for deliberate error logging in tests: wrap the call in assertLogs so the line is asserted but not emitted
States that 'Test: Warning' is the normal healthy badge for this project, so the badge is not the verdict
Does not conclude the build is broken from the card alone
